scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: A bank or SIM shop asks for your Aadhaar, an OTP arrives, and you're verified in seconds. What just happened?

scenes.name: request
scenes.text: The service is registered with UIDAI. When you share your Aadhaar number, it sends an authentication request to UIDAI's central system.

scenes.name: otp
scenes.text: UIDAI sends a one time password to the mobile number linked with your Aadhaar. Or you can verify with your fingerprint or iris.

scenes.name: match
scenes.text: UIDAI checks the OTP or biometrics against its records. For simple authentication, it only replies yes or no.

scenes.name: ekyc
scenes.text: For eKYC, with your consent, it sends back your name, address, date of birth and photo, digitally signed so it can't be faked.

scenes.name: vid
scenes.text: You can also use a sixteen digit Virtual ID instead of your Aadhaar number, so you don't have to share the real one.

scenes.name: safe
scenes.text: Never share an Aadhaar OTP with anyone who calls you. Real services only ask when you're the one starting the process.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Request, OTP, match, details. Verified in seconds. Follow for more on how things really work.
